basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at the HKUST NLP Group. Working on natural language processing and machine learning, with a focus on LLM reasoning and reinforcement learning, hallucination in vision-language models, and LLM truthfulness and interpretability.
